solve_case:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes edge latencies by converting negative input times into absolute receipt timestamps, propagating those timestamps through the edge list, and returning the latencies as a space-separated string." solve_case]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> in_times </REF>: list of int "Input times; positive values are fixed absolute times, negative values are pending receipt events, and zero is ignored in the initial fill passes."
        <REF> edges </REF>: list of (int, int) "Edge pairs in 1-based node indices; each pair is converted to 0-based indices for internal processing."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: str "Space-separated latency values in the same order as the input edges, with unmodified edges retaining the sentinel 10**6."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize latencies as a list of length len(edges) filled with the constant 10**6. RESULT latencies]
            [COMMAND Rebuild edges by mapping each original tuple (a, b) to (a - 1, b - 1). RESULT edges]
            [COMMAND Initialize abs_times as a list of length len(in_times) filled with the constant 10**6. RESULT abs_times]
            [COMMAND For each index and value i from enumerate(in_times), if i is strictly greater than 0, set abs_times[index] = i; zero and negative values leave abs_times unchanged. RESULT abs_times]
            [COMMAND Initialize pos_times as an empty list. RESULT pos_times]
            [COMMAND For each index and value i from enumerate(in_times), if i is strictly less than 0, append the tuple (abs(i), index) to pos_times; zero and positive values are ignored. RESULT pos_times]
            [COMMAND Sort pos_times in ascending order by tuple elements. RESULT pos_times]
            [COMMAND Initialize current_time to 0. RESULT current_time]
            [COMMAND Initialize received to 1. RESULT received]
            [COMMAND While pos_times is non-empty, evaluate pos_times[0][0]. If it equals received, increment current_time by 1, set new_received to 0, and then while pos_times is non-empty and pos_times[0][0] equals received, consume the front tuple: increment new_received, unpack it as a,b (a unused), set abs_times[b] = current_time, and remove that tuple from the front. After that inner loop, add new_received to received. Otherwise, build next_times from every abs_times value strictly greater than current_time, set current_time to min(next_times), compute received_count as the number of abs_times values less than or equal to the new current_time, and leave received and pos_times unchanged; received_count is not assigned back to received in this code path. RESULT pos_times, current_time, received, abs_times]
            [COMMAND After the while loop, prepend 0 to abs_times and reassign abs_times to the new list [0] + abs_times. RESULT abs_times]
            [COMMAND Build sorted_receipt as a list of (i, index) pairs for each index and value i from enumerate(abs_times). RESULT sorted_receipt]
            [COMMAND Sort sorted_receipt in ascending order by tuple elements. RESULT sorted_receipt]
            [COMMAND Iterate over time, comp in sorted_receipt[1:], skipping the artificial first entry. For each comp, scan edges in order with enumerate(edges). For each edge (A, B) at index index, if A == comp and abs_times[A] is strictly greater than abs_times[B], set latencies[index] = abs_times[A] - abs_times[B] and break the edge scan. Otherwise, if B == comp and abs_times[B] is strictly greater than abs_times[A], set latencies[index] = abs_times[B] - abs_times[A] and break the edge scan. If the timestamp comparison is false, do not break and continue scanning later edges. Self-loops never update because their timestamp difference is never strictly positive. Entries that never match remain at the sentinel 10**6. RESULT latencies]
            [COMMAND Return ' '.join(map(str, latencies)). RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: In the else branch of the outer while loop, no value in abs_times is strictly greater than current_time, so next_times is empty.]
        [LOG "min() arg is an empty sequence when evaluating current_time = min(next_times)"]
        [THROW ValueError "Raised because min() cannot be applied to an empty iterable."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
